design.candidate_rule: A candidate row is (tone gain g, demand, lactate survivor of P2J-3's primary filter at that g and demand, P2I-2AK surviving latent HR combination at that demand, baroreflex point (MAP_set, gain)). Its rules read L1, L3 and L3's two counterfactuals, which depend on the P3 set and the two cases' lactate-side points only, so a row's verdict is its (P3 set, 57m point, 72f point) HR unit's verdict; rows are counted with that multiplicity. SUPPORT is the latent region (combinations outside P2I-2AK's survivors never enter; counted per combination). DOMAIN is analytic (MAP_set > 0, gain >= 0, ceiling above both intrinsic rates, g primary, a = 0.3, the profile constructible); SIMULATION a run that stops or an HR missing; ARRIVAL the authored +-5 window for both cases (BAROREFLEX_REJECTION: every entering combination is arrival-compatible without the baroreflex, P2I-2AK); A-F hr_envelope_filter.failures unchanged. Every rule is read for every row; the first failure in ORDER is counted, every failure too.
design.double_counting_rule: Frozen, threshold-free. PATHOLOGICAL_DOUBLE_COUNTING when a structural probe A-D fails or, on a clinical minute, the baroreflex signal is negative or positive at MAP >= MAP_set (it would then be reading something else). Otherwise FUNCTIONALLY_REDUNDANT_IN_CURRENT_CASES when, on the pooled clinical pulse minutes (L1 and L3 of every entering HR unit, every tone gain and demand) at that MAP_set, no minute has exactly one of the two signals positive; STRUCTURALLY_DISTINCT_BUT_CORRELATED when some minute has exactly one positive. The Pearson correlation, the joint and single positive fractions, the drive shares and the ranking changes are reported, never thresholded. The overall class is the most severe across MAP_set candidates.
design.empty_rule: When no row survives ARRIVAL at any primary baroreflex point, demand and tone gain, the package stops with BAROREFLEX_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_ARRIVAL_HR (A-F still read, for the record). When rows pass ARRIVAL but none passes A-F, NOT_READY with NO_PRIMARY_SURVIVOR (the 'widespread failure of the certified HR A-F').

A.rule: untreated 57m (L1) HR at minute 120 within [authored arrival HR 124, 160]

B.rule: untreated 72f (L1) HR at minute 120 within [authored arrival HR 112, 150]

C.rule: at the minute L3 completes unit 1, HR(L3) <= HR(L3 without unit 1), each case

D.rule: at the minute L3 completes unit 2, HR(L3) <= HR(L3 without unit 2), each case

E.rule: after definitive management (L3), adequacy sustained from minute 60 at the latest through 120 and HR_120 <= HR_90 <= HR_60 (no tolerance), each case

F.rule: after definitive management (L3) HR at 120 minus intrinsic within [0, 15], each case

faculty.arrival: authored minute-0 HR 57m 124 and 72f 112 bpm, +-5 bpm, no residual offset, no wider tolerance, no case-specific MAP_set or gain, no change of the intrinsic grid; all candidates failing arrival stops with BAROREFLEX_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_ARRIVAL_HR
faculty.contribution: baroreflex_drive = baroreflex_to_sympathetic_gain x baroreflex_signal, added to the sympathetic target alongside the acute effective-deficit and the accumulated-debt drives; never derived from tau_D, the tone gain, the acute-deficit gain, the arrival HR or the legacy HR
faculty.double_counting: clinical audit (correlation, joint and single positivity, contribution shares, ranking changes); correlation is not rejected by itself; STRUCTURALLY_DISTINCT_BUT_CORRELATED / FUNCTIONALLY_REDUNDANT_IN_CURRENT_CASES / PATHOLOGICAL_DOUBLE_COUNTING with no correlation threshold
faculty.gain: 0 DIAGNOSTIC_NO_BAROREFLEX_REFERENCE; 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 primary exploratory support; none approved; the range is not extended after outcomes
faculty.hr_rules: P2I-2AK A-F repeated unchanged for every arrival-compatible candidate
faculty.latent: only P2I-2AK's surviving latent HR combinations, demand 1.0 and 1.1 separately; the HR grid is not reopened; no combination selected
faculty.map_set: 80 / 90 / 100 mmHg: exploratory common physiological reference candidates; not case-specific, individualized, approved or fitted to the arrival pressures; no value added after outcomes
faculty.old_term: the 1 - relative_pressure contribution (PRESSURE_TERM_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY) never active together with the baroreflex; retired from the primary HR physiology; no duplicate pressure signals
faculty.orthogonality: structural probes A-D before any clinical evaluation; no numeric gain approval from them
faculty.pressure: P2J-3 A-I must not change (HR feeds no pressure or output); any change stops the package
faculty.region: P2J-3 accepted (PRESSURE_TONE_OBSERVABLE_FILTER_SATISFIED); its primary region carried as the current primary uncertainty: tone gain g 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0, afterload a = 0.3 provisional, demand 1.0 and 1.1; none FACULTY_APPROVED; g 1.5 / 2.0 never in the primary baroreflex surface; g and a not further identified in this package
faculty.scope: shadow only; no runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, final baroreflex or HR latent approval, RR calibration, consciousness recalibration, collapse activation or legacy fitting
faculty.signal: MAP is the pressure signal: baroreflex_signal = max(0, (MAP_set - MAP) / MAP_set); 0 at or above MAP_set, positive below it, approaching 1 as MAP approaches 0, never negative (unlike the old 1 - relative_pressure term, which could go negative and cancel acute / debt drive)
faculty.timing: the baroreflex at minute t reads the pressure already resolved at t and adds to HR without changing pressure in that step; no algebraic pressure <-> HR loop; if HR fed output or pressure the package stops
faculty.upstream: BloodState, output, pressure, DO2, effective deficit, D, lactate and RR unchanged exactly

design.identifiability_rule: Frozen, on the primary survivors only (the gain-0 reference never counts). For a quantity with levels (MAP_set: 80 / 90 / 100; gain: 0.25 / 0.5 / 1 / 1.5), the survivor set of a level is the set of (tone gain, demand, HR unit, latent combination, other baroreflex coordinate) it keeps. WELL_CONSTRAINED when exactly one level keeps survivors; PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED when at least one level is emptied and two or more keep survivors; POORLY_IDENTIFIED when no level is emptied but the sets differ; NON_IDENTIFIABLE when every level keeps the same set. Interactions are read the same way on the admissible baroreflex points: COUPLED when the set of (MAP_set, gain) points a latent combination (acute / debt gains, intrinsic rates, ceiling) or a tone gain keeps differs across combinations or tone gains, UNCOUPLED when it is the same.
design.old_term_rule: Every P2J-4 profile carries hr_primary.PRIMARY_HR_CALIBRATION (sympathetic_per_pressure_deficit = 0), and the core refuses a profile with a baroreflex gain and a non-zero relative-pressure gain (CoreProfile). The common default keeps 1.0 with the baroreflex off, so the shadow baseline and the goldens stay identical; it never meets the baroreflex.
design.policy: Shadow only. P2J-3's and P2I-2AK's committed records and machinery; legacy HR and BP never read (LegacyLock), the P2F region never consumed (P2FGuard); MAP_set and gains predeclared and never extended; the relative-pressure term 0; HR never feeds pressure; nothing approved; RR, consciousness and collapse untouched.
design.probe_rule: Synthetic arrival states, structural only (no gain read from them): the neutral arrival (demand met, tone 1) with its authored pressure set to 72/44 (MAP 53) or 150/100 (MAP 117) mmHg and its demand 1 or 4 times the baseline, at a synthetic profile (reserve 2.5, acute 1, debt 0.01, baroreflex 1, relative pressure 0) and every MAP_set candidate (PROBE_MAP_SET for the expected classes). Each probe reads the acute drive (gain x acute_deficit_signal), the baroreflex drive (derived.baroreflex_drive) and the core target (sympathetic_target), which must equal their sum. Nothing writes T. A also serves as B6 (isolated hypotension), B as B7 (isolated oxygen deficit).
design.recommendation_rule: Frozen. If READY: ONE_MORE_BAROREFLEX_DECISION when (a) a tone-gain branch has no survivor at any primary point and demand, (b) the double-counting class is FUNCTIONALLY_REDUNDANT_IN_CURRENT_CASES, (c) a whole MAP_set or gain level is emptied (identifiability PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED or WELL_CONSTRAINED, a faculty choice the envelopes forced) or (d) one demand keeps no survivor at all; each names the decision. Otherwise RR_NEXT, carrying the surviving (MAP_set, gain) points with g and demand as uncertainty. RR is not started either way.
design.signal: baroreflex_signal = max(0, (MAP_set - MAP) / MAP_set), MAP = (SBP + 2 DBP) / 3 of the state as derive reports it (derived.mean_arterial_pressure, derived.baroreflex_signal); baroreflex_drive = baroreflex_to_sympathetic_gain x signal (derived.baroreflex_drive), added to the sympathetic target after the other terms; the target stays max(0, ...) and the drive keeps the common rise-at-once / tau 5 min decay
design.timing_rule: integration.step resolves every channel of minute t (blood, V, Hb, P, T, D) and the auxiliary lactate and demand, then sets the drive from sympathetic_target on that end state: the baroreflex reads MAP(t) of the same state derive reports at t, and HR(t) = intrinsic + saturated increment of drive(t). _perfusion (output, pressure, delivery) and every contributor read no drive and no HR, so HR(t) never reaches pressure at t or later: no algebraic loop, no solver, no added lag. The drive's existing memory (rises at once, decays with tau 5 min, KD-S2) is common to all its terms, not a baroreflex time constant.
design.verdict_rule: READY when: (1) some primary row survives (some baroreflex point with gain > 0, tone gain and demand); (2) every survivor is arrival-compatible and passes A-F (by the filter); (3) P2J-3's pressure / tone A-I results recompute exactly on the live core (units, primary filter, support, demand classes); (4) the baroreflex is non-negative and structurally distinct (probes A-D pass, no clinical sign violation, the double-counting class is not PATHOLOGICAL_DOUBLE_COUNTING); (5) no upstream change (every validation run: non-HR rows and every L3 state but the drive equal with the baroreflex on and off, the rebuilt HR equal to the core's, the drive never negative); (6) the gain-0 reference reproduces P2J-3's HR diagnostic (same rows, no A-F failure) and the latent region is P2I-2AK's; (7) the relative-pressure term is 0 in every profile used; (8) nothing is approved. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing check (BAROREFLEX_INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_ARRIVAL_HR when no row passes ARRIVAL at any primary point; NO_PRIMARY_SURVIVOR when rows pass ARRIVAL but none passes A-F).
